findings.title: Double-clicking Pay creates two orders and two charges
findings.impact: Customers are charged twice for one purchase
findings.likelihood: Common on slow connections where the first click seems to do nothing
findings.expected: One order and one charge per checkout
findings.expected_source: docs/spec.md#checkout: 'each checkout creates exactly one order'
findings.observed: Two POST /api/orders requests, two orders, two Paystack charges
minimal_repro: Go to /checkout with Paystack test card

root_cause_hypothesis.reasoning: Pay button not disabled while request pending; API has no idempotency key

fix.notes: Disabled button while pending and added idempotency key on POST /api/orders

findings.title: Sign-up rejects names with apostrophes or diacritics
findings.impact: Users with common Nigerian and Irish names cannot sign up with their real name
findings.expected: Names with apostrophes and diacritics are accepted
findings.observed: 'Name contains invalid characters' for Adébáyọ̀ and O'Neil

findings.title: Product grid overflows horizontally at 375px
findings.impact: Sideways scrolling on phones; layout looks broken
findings.likelihood: Only when a product title has a very long unbroken word
minimal_repro: Scroll to a product with a long title

findings.title: Webhook replay behaviour unverified
findings.blocking_fact: Need a test webhook signing secret to send signed sandbox events

findings.title: Filter chips misaligned
findings.rejection_reason: Matches the design file; tester expectation had no source

suggestions.text: Show the delivery fee before the payment step
